mathematical_context.title: The Analysis of Linear Partial Differential Operators III: Pseudo-Differential Operators
mathematical_context.locator: Global boundary calculus and Section24.7, in particular the complete residual terms in the global estimates.

receiving_contribution: One scalar full residual test for complete residual families on an arbitrary compact smooth global boundary, modulo the original Banach norm. Includes an atlas frame, a fully proved tangential smoothing square root and an integrable operator-valued normal quotient kernel.
